# An open grid edit has no witness under store activity

## Context

Leaf of #18762. D#17832's evidence bar asks the e2e tier for "sort and filter" with "record value, logical selection, active edit target and edit-session state" staying coherent; the delivered arms cover scroll-driven projection loss only. Neo's grids are built for stores that change under the user — streamed record updates, programmatic sort and filter — and no arm edits a cell while that happens.

unowned-rationale: probed while #18842 waited on CI; the recipe and results are below so any seat can land it. I am on #18838.

## The Problem

Probed at `dev@3f859a4803` on `test/playwright/component/apps/grid-cell-editing` (`#grid-cell-editing-pooled`, record 3, column `c3`, draft typed), driving the store from inside the App Worker:

| Store activity while the editor is open | Observed |
|---|---|
| another field of the edited record is set | editor, draft and focus stay; the other cell repaints |
| the edited field itself is set | draft and focus stay; Enter commits the draft over the pushed value |
| sort moves the record out of the row pool, then back | suspended (no editor in the DOM), then reprojected with the draft; focus is on `grid.View`, not the editor |
| a filter excludes the record, then is cleared | same as sort |
| the record is removed | no editor, no page error; `plugin.session` still holds the editor until the next `startEdit` ends it |

Nothing is red today except the reprojection focus, which is interaction-contract scope. Nothing guards any row of it either: every one can regress silently.

## The Architectural Reality

- The session is `{recordId, dataField, editor}` (`src/grid/plugin/CellEditing.mjs`); `isEmbodied` reads the row pool and the mounted column window, so sort and filter reach it only through the Row render — the path the scroll arms already prove for scrolling.
- A Brain-free spec cannot sort a store by pointer without ending the edit: a header click moves focus, and focus leaving the editor commits. The store has to be driven from the worker.
- `Neo.worker.App.loadModule({path})` imports a module inside the App Worker (component-tier precedent: `test/playwright/util/RmaHelpers.mjs`). A driver module that reads its action from its own query string (`new URL(import.meta.url).searchParams`) runs one store operation per call, in order, with a cache-busting counter.

## The Fix

Arms in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingPooling.spec.mjs` plus a fixture-owned driver, `test/playwright/component/apps/grid-cell-editing/storeDriver.mjs` (actions: set another field, set the edited field, sort by `id` DESC / ASC, filter `c3 like 'r1'` / clear, remove record 3). Each arm types a draft, drives the store, waits on the DOM (`data-record-id` rows leaving and returning, the sibling cell's text), and ends like the scroll arms: Escape restores the original value, or Enter commits the draft.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Streamed update to another field: editor, draft and DOM focus survive; the other cell shows the pushed value.
- [ ] Streamed update to the edited field: the draft survives, and Enter commits the draft.
- [ ] Sort out of the pool and back: no editor while away, reprojected with the draft on return, no leak into another cell (`recordLeaks`).
- [ ] Filter out and back: the same.
- [ ] Removing the edited record leaves no editor and no page error, and the next double-click on another cell edits.
- [ ] Runs in the CI e2e tier; no correctness sleeps; each arm killed by a named mutation recorded in the PR.

## Out of Scope

Focus returning to a reprojected editor (interaction-contract scope) · whether a removed record should end the session at removal rather than at the next edit — noted above, not decided here · store reload while editing.

## Avoided Traps

- **Header clicks or filter fields as the driver:** they take focus, the draft commits first, and the arm proves the focus-leave terminal instead.
- **A timer in the fixture mutating records:** unordered against the test's gestures; the query-string driver is ordered by construction.

- **Prescription checked:** `test/playwright/util/RmaHelpers.mjs` → `Neo.worker.App.loadModule({path})` (`src/worker/App.mjs`) owns the concern. A worker-side driver is the one way to mutate the store without moving focus.
- **Sharpening:** the arms go into a sibling spec, `test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingStoreActivity.spec.mjs`, on the same fixture and the shared `e2e/utils/gridCellEditing.mjs` helpers. @neo-fable's #18861 adds Tab arms to `CellEditingPooling.spec.mjs` in parallel, and store activity is its own axis.
